title: Playboy's Playmates of the Year La Creme de la Creme 1986 Special Edition
descriptionText:
Playboy's Playmates of the Year: La Crème de la Crème, special newsstand edition, November-December 1986. A retrospective collector's special featuring past Playmates of the Year.
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
